_comment: do.c dropx() asks dokick.c ship_object(), whose down_gate() ships only through a seen hole or trap door, then dropz() -> flooreffects(), whose shaft arm needs the hero to have escaped a seen one. A human Valkyrie wishes for a trap door under herself, which she does not fall through, drops her dagger and a food ration on it (dodrop() -> dropx()), and wishes for a mastodon corpse too heavy to hold ("Oops!", invent.c hold_another_object() -> dropx()); each lands on the floor. Seed, date, character and inputs chosen independently of batch 10.
